sourceRefs.locator: Results, Archaeology and extinctions, pp. 4–5, and Fig. 2C, F, H: biface 12080-1, Unit 3c, and seven adjacent dates

summary.en: Stone artefact 12080-1 from Unit 3c. Its excavators describe it as a reworked knife fragment. Its dating comes from adjacent material.
